title: Ancillary and Optional Services Billing: One Ancillary Account per Resident
content:
**Clause.** Under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing a resident has one ancillary billing account while in residence; a payer change moves the same account to another tier rather than opening a second one. A new account is set up only when the resident has no account that is pending setup or open. The limit is 1 (one) such account per resident.

## What the condition looks at

- **Whose accounts.** The resident's own ancillary accounts, matched by the resident.
- **Which states count.** An account that is pending setup or open. A closed account is not one of the two states named.
- **Evidence.** The company's account records, read before an account is set up. The status shown on the account record decides, not a statement about it.

## Condition table

| The resident's existing ancillary accounts on record | Is the condition for setting up a new account met? |
|---|---|
| An account pending setup | No |
| An account that is open | No |
| Only closed accounts | Yes |
| No account at all | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- **The stay's payer changes during residence.** The resident keeps the same account; it moves to the tier of the new payer, and no second account is opened for the new payer.
- **How many ancillary accounts can be pending setup or open for one resident at once?** At most 1.
